title: Guard Wine socket access before leasing the shared prefix
changes: Probe Unix-domain socket binding in a temporary directory before acquiring the shared Wine prefix lease, including when XDG_RUNTIME_DIR is unset.
validation: Wine-mode unit wine-socket-preflight-jtyb26w8 was refused on sandbox EPERM before Wine launched and retained no leases.
EUR Wine unit e134-default-managed-pair-wine-botzl4b6 passed with the preflight enabled and drained the Wine server.
limitations: The probe cannot grant sandbox permissions and cannot cover every runtime directory, socket path, race or filesystem failure; automatic approval review availability is external.
